functional.statement: Patient cells and tissue (32657043): 87.2% of granulocytes and 84.9% of monocytes LAMP2-deficient by flow cytometry; mosaic LAMP2 expression on cardiac IHC; WBC XCI not informative. 36876541 reports XCI by flow cytometry (75 heart, 86 WBCs). No construct assay.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: One-base deletion predicted to cause a frameshift (p.(Ala314GlnfsTer32)); the papers state the same protein change. Authors of 36876541 describe Danon disease as loss of function.

concerns: Review-table entry only in the batch row (36876541 Table 1 #1, citing Majer et al. 2012); no case description in that paper.

Carrier missing from the batch: 32657043 Patient #1 (same frameshift, 'III.2 in Majer et al.', onset 15, transplant 29) is very likely the same woman but is not a row for this candidate. 32657043 also cites a male patient III.3 from Majer et al. (shown in its Figure 1C) with no variant stated; relatives' genotypes are not given in these texts.
Cardiac phenotype is reported as HCM at 15 in 36876541 but as DCM in 32657043 Table 3 (possibly a dilated phase; not stated).
notes_for_panel: Evidence comes from second-hand summary tables; the primary report (Majer et al. 2012, Gene) is not in this batch.
